kodiak_recipe_card.title: Savory Castroville Artichoke + Marin Chevre KODIAK® Waffles
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped steamed Castroville artichoke hearts (cooled, drained)
2–3 tbsp crumbled Marin chevre / Harley Farms fresh chevre (plus more for topping)
1 tsp olive oil (plus drizzle to finish)
Pinch sea salt + cracked pepper; optional chive
steps: Steam Castroville artichoke hearts until tender, chop to 1/2-inch, cool and drain.
Whisk KODIAK® mix, milk, egg, 1 tsp olive oil; fold in chopped hearts and 2 tbsp chevre crumbles — do not overmix.
Waffle on hot iron per mix directions; top each hot waffle with remaining chevre so it softens, drizzle olive oil, cracked pepper, chive.
Serve beside Arcangeli artichoke bread or Fifth Crow strawberry compote if in May-Sep crossover.
kodiak_recipe_card.pancake_tip: Fold chopped steamed artichoke hearts + Marin chevre into savory KODIAK® waffles — savory, not sweet; olive oil not syrup
kodiak_recipe_card.nutrition_cue: 14g protein + 100% whole grains per serving (per KODIAK® Power Cakes) — savory frontier protein where the artichoke is the vegetable
kodiak_recipe_card.photo_plate: Savory waffle on a weathered crate, artichoke hearts visible in the grid, white chevre crumble, olive oil sheen, Pescadero Marsh fog behind
